methods.content_control: Restrict candidates to the query's recorded prompt class: eight briefs/class. This is not independent visual content validation.
methods.distance: Euclidean distance to each brief's mean of the two other repetitions; held repetition excluded from every centroid. Train/test use the same condition.
methods.identity_tables: Every prediction joins prediction_sets on prediction_set_id and queries on query_id. Splits use those same query IDs for exact training-image and held-image membership; no features are duplicated.
methods.interpretation: Within-condition repeat retrieval describes scene-associated geometry. Uniform contraction preserves retrieval and naming can reduce noise enough to improve it. Neither direction establishes causal scene fidelity, painter style, human perception or new-scene generalization. There are no p-values, population intervals or new generation calls.
methods.mass: Every one of the 24 fixed briefs and three held repetitions has equal mass; all three classes have eight briefs. No resampling or model tuning.
methods.ties: Exact equality of computed float64 Euclidean distances; no tolerance. Top1 and deterministic rank use lexical brief ID; also report all nearest ties, fractional tie top1, and average best/worst rank (midrank).
methods.trace_scope: Equal-mass empirical between-brief/within-brief traces match each view and scope. Pooled same-content between trace centers each brief mean within its recorded class, removing between-class variation.
methods.transform: Unchanged per-pipeline development-scaled coordinates supplied by the retained loader; no generated-data scaler, PCA or tuned metric.

assumptions: New prompts, delivery versions, instruction polarities and selected templates can have different noise than these pooled historical prompts.
Generic-clause noise is an unvalidated pooled artist-free proxy, not observed generic-clause OAuth data. Free and generic draws are distinct simulated requests.
Historical artist-free allocations are centered separately by painter/brief; pooling them does not establish service/time equivalence.
Three-repeat residual correction preserves marginal sample variance, not independence, tail fidelity, or future heteroskedasticity.

scope: Exposed-data falsification and prospective sensitivity; no new images.

assumptions: Conditional on the six fixed templates and their equal weights; no new-scene inference.
Independent replicate blocks with stable within-template distributions; block-common additive disturbances cancel in the response interactions.
Welch–Satterthwaite t inference is approximate, including under non-Gaussian noise; randomized dispatch does not make a weak zero-interaction test exact.
The two primary intervals use Bonferroni allocation of the family alpha. Holm-adjusted two-sided p-values are reported separately.
Any unavailable planned measurement withholds primary inference. Complete-block survivor summaries cannot identify the originally allocated response effect.
